sources.title: Jakemu/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-int8-g128-mtp · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B INT8 group-128 + MTP Custom infer-opt weight-only W8A16 checkpoint, including the MTP head. This is a text-only inference export. Load with infer-opt, not Transformers AutoModel or vLLM. Routers, small gates, norms, embeddings and lm_head retain BF16 weights. Quantization uses symmetric round-to-nearest, group size 128, with BF16 scales and no calibration dataset.
